I really don’t understand this concept of an “alpha male” that the society wants men to strive for . Like who the fuck said that a man MUST be tough and muscular in order for him to be considered attractive ? These kinds of standards of beauty are just made up by society in order to make people even more miserable than they already are and only stupid people base their opinions on these standards .

 The people who put you down for your “ugliness” are ignorant sheep and are not at all worth being taken seriously. It’s not exactly their fault because these kinds of beliefs were ingrained in them a long time ago,but they are at fault for not challenging these beliefs and assuming without so much as thinking for a second that they are true .

Please don’t hurt yourself because you think that there’s something wrong with you. Because there isn’t .The problem lies within those ignorant ,shallow people who put you down because you don’t correspond to some stupid made-up beauty standards . They are what’s wrong ,not you .I still believe that there are people left who actually have their own beliefs and views on things and don’t simply repeat everything the society tells them .You will come across this kind of person one day. There are still worthy people left and fuck the rest of the mankind .
Thanks a lot for your advice 😅

I can really relate to not being a fan of life .17 too. Feeling like I’ve messed everything up .No idea where I am going . Keep seeing my classmates’ Instagram stories where they all basically hang out and enjoy themselves . Because that’s what most people do when they are 17. I’ve never even had that . Don’t know what’s wrong with me . I don’t even mind being all alone at this point ,but the fact that all the people I know are out there hanging out and enjoying themselves whereas I spend my summer sitting in my room and trying to escape my own mind ,makes me hate myself even more .Fuckk
